rationale: Central chronological press/announcement feed for Slovenian banking and payments; primary monitoring endpoint.
Master catalogue of recurring BS reports; backbone of periodic disclosure collection.
Release calendar mined to schedule polling; not a continuous signal producer itself.
Legally compelled supervisory disclosures and supervised-entity lists; recurring, high-credibility.
Enforcement register is high signal but URL failed; re-check liveness/canonical path before approval.
Authoritative register of banks, payment and e-money institutions; canonical actor map, continuously updated.
Statutory e-money issuer register, in scope for payments; URL failed, verify current path.
EEA passported PSP list is a valuable one-time lead mine; URL failed, re-check.
Oversight sub-hub on bsi.si covered by monitoring the BS publications/press parents.
Official payment and financial-institution statistics; quantitative baseline for market sizing.
Monthly banking-system aggregates; highest-frequency official sector-health signal.
Reporting-framework sub-page of bsi.si; definitional value only, parent coverage suffices.
Sanctions-compliance guidance sub-page; occasional updates surface via BS press hub.
Whistleblowing institutional page produces no recurring intelligence signal.
Issuer list seeds the A1 disclosure universe; mine once, but URL failed and legal status unclear.
OAM statutory repository of regulated information; highest-value single endpoint for A1 disclosures.
ATVP enforcement decisions are in scope but URL failed; re-verify before monitoring.
ESEF guidance is static reference material determining parseability, not a recurring feed; link failed.
Regulator annual reports plus IJZ catalogue are useful recurring/pointer content; URL failed.
Prospectus-procedure sub-page of a-tvp.si; value lies in approval lists, link unverified.
AZN statutory annual market reports with insurance/bancassurance statistics; reachable PDF archive.
Agent/broker register is a distribution-layer actor map best mined once then archived.
Reporting-requirements section of a-zn.si; parent monitoring covers changes.
FOI decision search is an occasional discovery route, not a core banking/payments feed.
AJPES JOLP is the canonical store of Slovenian annual reports for banks, PSPs and vendors.
Documentation of report types on ajpes.si; supports JOLP collection design, no standalone feed.
Disclosure calendar mined to time JOLP crawls precisely.
Business register searchable by SKD enumerates the banking/payments/vendor universe; mine to seed actors.
